_employee: E007 (Priya Tanaka, Data Engineer). Claims are the kind of sentence a generated plan might contain.
_checker: A claim is grounded when every value in must_find appears together on one line of the rendered context packet (pda.prompts.render_packet), matched on token boundaries so that '0 USD' does not match inside '300 USD'. Values are written as they appear in the packet, not as they appear in the claim, because the checker verifies the packet, not the prose. The labels are ground truth; the eval reports how often the checker agrees with them, then applies the checker to the real plan.
